skill.name: trend-spotter
skill.description: Use when the user asks to find trending topics, assess whether a brand should join a cultural moment, or time influencer content around platform trends. It produces ranked trend reports with brand-fit scores, format status, cultural-calendar timing, and go, caution, or skip recommendations. It does not select creators; use influencer-discovery for that next step.
skill.summary: Ranks social trends with brand-fit scores, timing calls, and go, caution, or skip recommendations.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

content.value_statement: Fast social trends can waste budget when they do not fit the brand. This skill ranks trends, scores fit, and recommends when to act.
actual_capabilities: Defines trend analysis inputs, including brand, audience, platforms, geography, and time horizon.
Ranks topics, hashtags, sounds, and challenges with relevance, lifespan, and brand-safety notes.
Scores each candidate trend across audience fit, brand fit, adaptability, risk, and timing.
Builds a cultural calendar with lead times, seasonal moments, and conversations to avoid.
Creates top-three act-now lists, watch lists, avoid lists, and next-step handoffs.
limitations: Live trend data requires user-provided evidence or optional connector use.
It does not find or vet creators for campaign execution.
Trend volume and platform metrics must be verified before budget decisions.
It cannot guarantee that a trend will remain safe or effective after publication.

use_cases.title: Plan a Weekly Content Sprint
use_cases.description: Identify which trends deserve posts this week and which ones should remain on a watch list.

use_cases.title: Vet a Cultural Moment
use_cases.description: Score a hashtag, sound, or challenge for audience fit, brand fit, timing, and risk before joining.

use_cases.title: Brief an Influencer Campaign
use_cases.description: Turn selected trends into format guidance, timing windows, creator direction, and risk mitigations.

prompt_templates.title: Find Current Trends
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner scan for a brand or industry.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find current trends for [brand or industry] on [platforms] for [audience] in [region]. Rank the best opportunities for this week.

prompt_templates.title: Decide Go or Skip
prompt_templates.prompt: Should [brand] participate in [trend]? Score audience fit, brand fit, adaptability, risk, and timing. Give a go, caution, or skip call.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cultural Calendar
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan trend timing across a campaign window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cultural calendar for [brand] from [start date] to [end date]. Include lead times, content formats, and moments to avoid.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Multi-Source Trend Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced report with competitor and evidence review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [brand] trends across [platforms] using the evidence I provide. Include competitor adoption, confidence notes, act-now trends, watch-list items, and avoid-list items.

output_examples.input: What TikTok trends should a fitness brand run this week?
output_examples.output: A ranked report names three act-now trends, assigns brand-fit scores, recommends short-video formats, lists hashtags, and flags trends to avoid.

output_examples.input: Should our skincare brand join this challenge?
output_examples.output: A go, caution, or skip recommendation explains audience alignment, brand values, content adaptability, risk, timing, and safer alternatives.

output_examples.input: Plan trend themes for a back-to-school creator campaign.
output_examples.output: A cultural calendar shows preparation windows, platform formats, creator brief angles, seasonal opportunities, and the next trend review date.

best_practices: Provide the target audience, geography, platforms, and time horizon before asking for recommendations.
Label unverified volume signals as estimated until two independent sources support the trend.
Use the skip list as actively as the act-now list when protecting brand safety.
anti_patterns: Do not join a trend only because it is viral without checking brand fit.
Do not treat single-source spikes as proof of durable momentum.
Do not reuse competitor executions without adapting the format and risk controls.

faq.question: Does this skill pull live social platform data by itself?
faq.answer: No. It can reason from user-provided evidence, and it documents optional connector recipes for public trend signals.

faq.question: Can it choose influencers for the selected trends?
faq.answer: No. It recommends trend directions and handoffs. Use influencer-discovery to build the creator shortlist.

faq.question: What platforms can it evaluate?
faq.answer: It can structure analysis for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, search trends, and other user-specified platforms.

faq.question: How are go, caution, and skip calls made?
faq.answer: The skill scores audience alignment, brand value fit, content adaptability, risk level, and timing window.

faq.question: Can it help with brand safety?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks for conversations to avoid, risk levels, mitigation notes, and skip recommendations.

faq.question: Is it useful without integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides templates and reasoning steps, but live evidence improves confidence in time-sensitive calls.
